svg.title: Play: teach the model. Every tile is a live prediction from a small neural network trained by visitors. Click a tile to add a training point.
svg.text: A NEURAL NETWORK TRAINED BY VISITORS

g.text: Every tile below is a live prediction from a small neural network: a red 1 or a black 0.
Click any tile to place a training point there. A GitHub Action retrains the network from
scratch and redraws the board for everyone, usually within a minute.
2 → 16 → 1 MLP · TANH · ADAM · 600 EPOCHS · PURE PYTHON, NO LIBRARIES
